challenges.title: A tiny JUnit-style runner
challenges.prompt: Complete run(): discover @Test methods by reflection (sorted by name), create a fresh instance per test, run @BeforeEach methods, and report PASS/FAIL, honoring @Test(expected=...). Finish with a summary line.
challenges.expected:
PASS adds
FAIL fails: AssertionError expected 99
PASS freshStatePerTest
PASS throwsExpected
FAIL wrongException: IllegalArgumentException x
3 passed, 2 failed
challenges.explain: This is how JUnit works conceptually: annotations mark tests, a fresh instance per test gives isolation, and an exception either fails the test or satisfies `expected`. Verified by running the solution with java Main.java.

challenges.title: Test doubles for a checkout
challenges.prompt: Implement Checkout.pay: reject non-positive amounts before touching the gateway, charge, email a receipt on success and return PAID, otherwise DECLINED. The fake gateway and spy mailer record interactions so the assertions can verify them.
challenges.expected:
PAID
DECLINED
rejected: amount must be positive
gateway calls: [ada:500, bo:700]
emails: [ada|receipt 500]
no email for declined: true
gateway untouched for invalid amount: true
challenges.explain: A fake gateway controls outcomes and a spy mailer records calls, so behavior and interactions can be asserted without real services. Verified by running the solution with java Main.java.
